details.command: powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$root='E:\DEV\Codex-web'; Set-Location -LiteralPath $root; $paths=@(git diff --name-only; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard) | Where-Object { $_ -and $_ -notlike '.coding-tools/*' } | Sort-Object -Unique; function Snap($ps){ $m=@{}; foreach($p in $ps){ if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $p -PathType Leaf){ try{$m[$p]=(Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $p).Hash}catch{} } }; return $m }; $a=Snap $paths; Start-Sleep -Seconds 3; $b=Snap $paths;
